min_date = df['dt'].min()
max_date = df['dt'].max()

# Create full date range
all_dates = pd.date_range(start=min_date, end=max_date, freq='D')

# Get unique users
users = df['user'].unique()

# Create MultiIndex with all combinations
multi_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([users, all_dates], names=['user', 'dt'])

# Create new DataFrame with full combinations
full_df = pd.DataFrame(index=multi_index).reset_index()

# Merge with original data
result = pd.merge(full_df, df, on=['user', 'dt'], how='left')

# Fill missing values with 0
